scenes.title: The Register
scenes.source_summary: Vesper’s census begins as an apparently neutral service record, then determines access to ambulances, housing and exams. A clerk questions the claim that numbers are morally neutral.

scenes.continuity_notes: Make administrative procedure quietly ominous; seed the registry motif.

continuity_rules: Kaylen is the sole survivor of the Grave Choir ambush; every other crew member present is confirmed dead.
Juno’s notebook, Tovin’s unfinished school application and Leona’s naming campaign return with consequences.
Nia’s murder is revealed in stages; Kaylen’s responsibility is never erased.
PTSD is varied, non-linear and consequential; it is not a superpower and does not make people inherently violent.
Ethiopia is plural, imperfect and politically contested, not a flawless refuge.
No population is morally uniform; distinguish institutions, leaders, collaborators, resisters and civilians.
The fictional ninety-percent European resident-population death figure is mass atrocity, never a victory score.
Do not expand Book Two beyond the defined unresolved transmission at the end of Book One.
